regions.text: の直接性にあつては、偶然は、正視態として直態として、現在に位置を有つ限り時間性釣優位を占めたものである。

quote.translation: In the immediacy of experience, the contingent, as the mode of looking straight on, as the direct mode, holds temporal priority insofar as it has its position in the present.

regions.text: また瞬間としての永遠の現在の鼓動にほかならないものである。

quote.translation: It is, moreover, nothing other than the pulse of the eternal present as the instant.

regions.text: 考察の結果に基いて可能と必然と偶然の時間性格を上のやうな岡形で表はすことができる。

quote.translation: On the basis of this consideration, the temporal characters of the possible, the necessary and the contingent can be represented by the figure above 〔Figure 17〕.

regions.text: 以上に於て、偶然性の時間性格として現在任を把握したが、同時にまた偶然性と現賞との密接な踊保も明かにされたと思ふ。

quote.translation: In grasping presentness as the temporal character of contingency, I think we have at the same time made clear the close relation between contingency and actuality.

regions.text: 様相の第一體系にあっては偶然性は理賞堂の静約地平に於て必然性と矛眉對當をなすものと規定された。

quote.translation: In the first system of modality, contingency was determined as standing in contradictory opposition to necessity on the static horizon of actuality.

regions.text: 第二體系にあつては、現實は動的に問題化され、問題現實の現實性を構成するものとして偶然性と可能性とが小反對對當の関係に於て目撃された。

quote.translation: In the second system, the actual was problematised dynamically, and contingency and possibility were witnessed in the relation of subcontrary opposition, as constituting the actuality of problematic actuality.

regions.text: 第三鐙系におつては、偶然性は不可能性と大小對當の近接開係にあるものとして歳無性の次元に於て把握されながら、それに

quote.translation: In the third system, contingency was grasped in the dimension of nihility, as standing with impossibility in the relation of proximity that belongs to subalternation, and yet, for all that, it was understood as proclaiming its own actuality as the birth of the actual (see p. 237).
